metadata.title: SLOPE: Sorted L1 Penalized Estimation
metadata.description: Efficient implementations for Sorted L-One Penalized Estimation (SLOPE): generalized linear models regularized with the sorted L1-norm (Bogdan et al. (2015) ). Supported models include ordinary least-squares regression, binomial regression, multinomial regression, and Poisson regression. Both dense and sparse predictor matrices are supported. In addition, the package features predictor screening rules that enable fast and efficient solutions to high-dimensional problems.
metadata.notes: If you use this software, please cite our article on arXiv.

metadata.title: MODAVIS VAO Importer for Unity
metadata.description:
Import, inspect, and run Virtual Acoustic Object (VAO) 0.4.0 carriers in Unity. The package validates a .vao before extraction, creates a typed VaoPackageAsset, imports supported media, builds linked MIDI animations, and can generate a runtime prefab for desktop, mobile, and XR applications.

This is release candidate 0.6.0-rc.1. It targets Unity 6 (6000.0 or newer) and is tested with Unity 6000.5.9f1.

 

This software was developed during the PhD project MODAVIS (2022–2026), supported by the German Academic Scholarship Foundation (Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes).

metadata.title: Orbit-resolved spectra and dynamical accessibility in multi-register covering Hamiltonians
metadata.description:
Reproducibility artifact for the associated theory manuscript on orbit-resolved spectra and dynamical accessibility in multi-register covering Hamiltonians. The release contains the manuscript source and PDF, frozen and hashed Set Cover instances, exact and residual-aware numerical audits, generated tables, and the code required to reproduce them.

The artifact has scope-specific open licenses: original software in code/ is MIT; original manuscript material, documentation, generated results, and project-authored data are CC BY 4.0; redistributed OR-Library material retains J. E. Beasley's MIT notice; and the official quantumarticle.cls and quantum.bst package files retain LPPL 1.3c. See the top-level LICENSE and LICENSES/ for the controlling notices.

creators.affiliation: Instituto de Física Gleb Wataghin, Universidade Estadual de Campinas

metadata.description: ASTRID is a local-first, multimodal tool for auditing dataset reliability and risk in industrial AI. metadata.title: CROC Core v6 Reproducibility Package: A Novel Cancellation-Resolution Ownership Consistency Algorithm for Asynchronous WebAssembly Components
metadata.description:
This record provides the final Core v6 reproducibility package for the study:

“CROC: A Novel Cancellation-Resolution Ownership Consistency Algorithm for Asynchronous WebAssembly Components.”

CROC is a trace-based decision algorithm for checking cancellation-resolution ownership consistency in asynchronous WebAssembly component executions. The final Core v6 formulation tracks task lifecycle state, cancellation requests, resource ownership, explicit borrowed-handle identities and multiplicity, and resolution-specific obligations for returned, cancelled-before-started, and cancelled-before-returned outcomes.

This package freezes the executable Core v6 implementation used by the final manuscript together with the validation scripts, experiment artifacts, raw performance measurements, manifests, and formal correctness material.

Final validation evidence included in this release comprises:

• Exact Core v5/Core v6 historical equivalence on 4,300/4,300 cases.

• Independent bounded exhaustive validation with complete agreement on:
  – 3,180/3,180 legal prefixes;
  – 17,937/17,937 bounded one-step decisions;
  – 9,540/9,540 resolution decisions;
  – 5,336/5,336 independently determined resolution diagnostic checks; and
  – 954/954 multi-borrow resolution cases.

• Core v6 performance evaluation across 18 configurations and 720 measured repetitions, including raw timing samples, dispersion statistics, bootstrap confidence intervals, Python allocation measurements, and fresh-process Windows RSS measurements.

• Scalability evaluation up to 10,000 tasks. The 10,000-task clean configuration completed in a median of 15.063 ms with a p95 of 15.535 ms, while the late-cancellation configuration completed in a median of 18.173 ms with a p95 of 18.768 ms.

• Borrow-width evaluation up to 1,024 explicit borrowed handles.

• A formal correctness package containing the prefix-state invariant, resolution characterization, borrow-multiplicity preservation proposition, decision-correctness theorem, first-witness minimality theorem, and deterministic diagnostic-selection corollary.

The independent bounded exhaustive validation is exhaustive over its explicitly defined finite model. The formal correctness results are stated relative to the normalized CROC event semantics implemented by the frozen Core v6.

Final Core v6 SHA-256:
ab9d8e6626927fe35ca7685323efc201835432eaffe679bcb109d3c18dd8d01b

Reproducibility package ZIP SHA-256:
9b47bc7f3ffa5d1aa199669e266de5c7901d409657aca6eff835acff9ef1e97e

hits.title: CROC Core v6 Reproducibility Package: A Novel Cancellation-Resolution Ownership Consistency Algorithm for Asynchronous WebAssembly Components
